title: Ambubachi Mela
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
info: Annual festival of the goddess Kamakhya
body:
The Ambubachi Mela is an annual festival at the Kamakhya Temple in Guwahati, held in June during the monsoon, when the goddess Kamakhya is believed to undergo her annual menstruation cycle.

What happens

The temple is closed for three days, then reopened amid large crowds of pilgrims, sadhus and visitors. Devotees receive prasad in the form of cloth and other items, and the city hosts fairs and processions.

Importance

Ambubachi is one of Assam's biggest religious gatherings and a major event for the Shakti tradition, drawing pilgrims from across India and beyond.
